## About me {#about-me}

I am a Ph.D. student in the Department of Politics at [**Princeton University**](https://politics.princeton.edu/), specializing in international relations. My research focuses on international security, particularly how states respond to the threat or use of force through trade, alliance politics, and security institutions.

I received my Bachelor of Laws (LL.B.) from the [**University College of London**](https://www.ucl.ac.uk/), Master of International and Public Affairs (MIPA) from the [**University of Hong Kong**](https://www.hku.hk/en), and Master of International Affairs (MIA) from the [**National University of Singapore**](https://www.nus.edu.sg/). 

Before joining Princeton, I worked as a research assistant at the National University of Singapore's Lee Kuan Yew School of Public Policy, Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC), and Asia Competitiveness Institute.
